claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pefloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibacterial with weak eukaryotic topoisomerase II (TOP2A) inhibition; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled human cancer cell line screen it is expected to be largely inactive, since antibacterial fluoroquinolones lack meaningful cytotoxicity against human cells at low micromolar concentrations.
